abstract: Covers SCIM 2.0 for both service providers and clients: the RFC 7643 core schema (attribute characteristics, common attributes, User, Group, Enterprise User extension, schema definitions), the RFC 7644 protocol (endpoints, create, query, filters, sorting, PUT, PATCH, DELETE, Bulk, /Me, errors, ETags, discovery, multi-tenancy and security), RFC 9865 cursor pagination, RFC 9967 security events and asynchronous requests, RFC 7523 JWT client authentication, and the draft IPSIE AL and FastFed SCIM profiles. SKILL.md holds the invariants and workflow; references split out schema, protocol, pagination, discovery, security, profiles and events.
